wilds.name: Multiplier Wild
wilds.behavior:
The Multiplier Wild symbol substitutes for any payout symbol and adds its value to the global multiplier when part of a winning combination.
Coin symbols pay out the displayed value times the bet and multiplied by the global multiplier when they have a clear path to the topmost row.

base_game_loop.summary: World Eaters: paid spin on 5x5. Collector Wins. Avalanche/tumble after wins. Bonus modes: Bonus, Super Bonus. Round ends on win cap if reached.

phases.name: Place bet and spin
phases.what_happens: Player selects bet and hits Spin (or Auto Spin). Optional: activate an X-iter mode from base game only before the drop/spin.
phases.state_changes: Bet locked; optional X-iter mode selected

phases.name: Initial symbol drop/spin
phases.what_happens: Symbols land on 5x5. Game-specific setup features may fire (birds, Nitro/COOL reels, collectors, etc.).
phases.ends_when: All symbols at resting positions / reels stopped

phases.name: Remove winners and Avalanche
phases.what_happens: Winning symbols explode/are removed; remaining symbols fall; new symbols drop in. Continues while new wins appear.
phases.ends_when: No new winning combinations after a fill
phases.state_changes: Grid updated; avalanche chain may continue

phases.name: End-of-drop features
phases.what_happens: Resolve end-of-round features (bombs, mystery reveals, row swaps, boosters, etc.) if nothing else can happen; may resume avalanches.

phases.name: Bonus trigger check
phases.what_happens: If bonus/super-bonus trigger conditions met, enter bonus mode after resolving same-drop features. Otherwise settle base-game wins subject to win cap.
phases.state_changes: Enter bonus mode or settle base round

modes.name: Bonus
modes.trigger: 3 Bonus symbols trigger the Bonus game with 3 Super drops.
modes.end_condition: Ends when no free drops/spins remain or when the win cap has been reached.

phases.name: Free drop/spin loop
phases.what_happens: Play free drops/spins with base mechanics plus bonus-mode persistence/retriggers as described in Game rules.
phases.ends_when: No free drops/spins remain or win cap reached

phases.name: Settle
phases.what_happens: Pay bonus-mode winnings at end of bonus (or immediately on win cap).

modes.name: Super Bonus
modes.trigger: Super bonus symbol combination triggers the super bonus game
modes.effects: Super bonus symbol combination triggers the super bonus game
modes.end_condition: Ends when no free drops/spins remain or when the win cap has been reached.

phases.name: Start Super Bonus
phases.what_happens: Super bonus symbol combination triggers the super bonus game
phases.state_changes: Super bonus flags; often max grid / guaranteed features

phases.name: Free drop/spin loop
phases.what_happens: Play free drops/spins under super-bonus rules.
phases.ends_when: No free drops/spins remain or win cap reached

phases.name: Settle
phases.what_happens: Pay winnings at end of bonus mode (or on win cap).

During the X-iter modes, the grid size is 7x7.
A UFO feature symbol appears in the X-iter mode.
The following features do not appear in the X-iter modes: Whale, Pipe, Fireworks, Tree and Volcano.
An X-iter feature is purchased by pressing the X-iter button, selecting X-iter mode showing the cost in the player's currency, and pressing the Spin button.
The X-iter features can only be activated in the base game.
The theoretical payout (RTP) for all X-iter game modes are __RTP__.
The minimum X-iter cost is __MINBABMODE__, the maximum X-iter cost is __MAXBABMODE__.
All game rules apply in X-iter mode.
